name: ugt-core
description: Stack-agnostic org foundation shared by every UGT stack platform: the ugt-handoff work-state skill, the ugt-context knowledge-base bootstrap (docs/project-context/), the ugt-model-mode model-routing skill, the ugt-requirements per-feature brief skill, the audit-trail hooks, and the normative contracts (database naming, cicd pipeline, auth/RBAC, UI design standard, harness mechanism) that stack platforms render in their own terms. Installed automatically as a dependency of ugt-<stack>-platform plugins — never installed directly.
